units.source_text: 卫门佐、藏人，都是在天皇御前供职的。

en.t: The Emon no suke and the kurodo were both officials who served in the emperor's presence.
Their court rank was either the sixth rank or the fifth rank.

units.source_text: 六位者穿青袍，五位者穿红袍。

en.t: Those of the sixth rank wore blue robes, while those of the fifth rank wore red robes.
